Record Class ResolvedModule

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.micronaut.python.imports.ResolvedModule
Record Components:
module - The Python module name
documentation - The module documentation, or null
members - The exported names, sorted, to their targets
clashes - The clashes decided while resolving, with their winners
active - Whether the module is available: the first source of a contribution is on the class path
inactiveReason - Why the module is not available, or null when it is
public record ResolvedModule(String module, @Nullable String documentation, Map<String, ResolvedModule.Member> members, List<ResolvedModule.Clash> clashes, boolean active, @Nullable String inactiveReason) extends Record
A curated module resolved against a class path: the names it exports and the targets they stand for.
Since:
5.3.0
Author:
Graeme Rocher
